rule_en: wish/if only + past simple = a present regret (I wish I had more time). wish + past perfect = a past regret (I wish I had tested it). wish + would = an annoying habit you want changed.
rule_bn: বর্তমান আক্ষেপ → wish + past simple; অতীত আক্ষেপ → wish + past perfect; অন্যের বিরক্তিকর অভ্যাস → wish + would।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: I wish I have more time for code reviews
items.explain_en: A present wish takes the past simple: wish + had.

items.prompt_en: She wishes she didn't accepted the meeting invite
items.explain_en: A past regret → wish + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: If only the build would passes before the demo
items.explain_en: would + base verb: pass.

items.prompt_en: I wish my laptop will stop freezing during screen shares
items.explain_en: An annoying habit → wish + would, never 'will'.

items.prompt_en: He wishes he can join the offsite next month
items.explain_en: wish shifts 'can' back to 'could'.

items.prompt_en: I wish I am not the only one who updates the wiki
items.explain_en: Present unreal after wish → were/weren't for every person.

items.prompt_en: If only we listened to QA before we shipped that build
items.explain_en: A regret about a finished past event → if only + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: I wish you wouldn't to push directly to main
items.explain_en: wish + would(n't) + base verb.

items.prompt_en: She wishes she knows the answer during yesterday's interview
items.explain_en: 'yesterday' makes it a past regret → wish + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: I wish there is a faster way to refresh this sandbox
items.explain_en: wish + past (were) for a present reality you want different.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: I wish I ___ to the architecture review last week.
items.explain_en: A past regret → wish + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: She wishes her commute ___ shorter.
items.explain_en: A present wish about a state → past simple 'were'.

items.prompt_en: I wish the printer ___ jamming every Monday morning.
items.explain_en: A recurring annoyance → wish + would + base.

items.prompt_en: If only I ___ the backup before running the delete script.
items.explain_en: A past regret → if only + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: I wish I ___ speak French as well as you do.
items.explain_en: An ability you lack now → wish + could.

items.prompt_en: I wish we ___ fewer meetings on Fridays.
items.explain_en: A present wish → past simple: had.

items.prompt_en: He wishes he ___ the job offer in writing before resigning.
items.explain_en: A past regret → wish + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: If only this dashboard ___ in real time.
items.explain_en: A present wish → past simple after 'if only'.

items.prompt_en: I wish you ___ your changes before pushing them.
items.explain_en: Asking someone to change a habit → wish + would.

items.prompt_en: I wish I ___ on a beach right now instead of in this meeting.
items.explain_en: A 'right now' wish → were.
